sections.heading: About the Show
sections.body: Unprofessional is a quarterly night of cabaret, where you never quite know what you'll get. Launched on Maya Suess's birthday in February 2022, the show lives in the back room of The Parkside Lounge on Houston and Attorney in the Lower East Side.

sections.heading: The Unprofessional Variety show is a queer revelation. Maya is the most genial and varied host in all her incarnations. She's assembled an audience of supportive and sexy queers around her and her carefully composed collection of performers. Each show is unlike its predecessors and each one an exploration of how to build a joyful and resilient Queerness. This is easily my favorite variety show and I want everyone to see it!
Get Involved
sections.body: Want to perform? Have a wild idea? Just want to be part of whatever this is? Reach out. The show is built by its community, and the door is always open.
